title: A/R Summary: Current, 1-30 Days and 31-60 Days sort largest first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have three new customers (created for this test), customer A, customer B and customer C, with open invoices on today's date with these open amounts per column:
  • Customer A: Current $100.00, 1-30 Days $200.00, 31-60 Days $300.00, 61-90 Days $250.00, 91 And Over $350.00, Total $1,200.00.
  • Customer B: Current $300.00, 1-30 Days $100.00, 31-60 Days $200.00, 61-90 Days $350.00, 91 And Over $150.00, Total $1,100.00.
  • Customer C: Current $200.00, 1-30 Days $300.00, 31-60 Days $100.00, 61-90 Days $150.00, 91 And Over $250.00, Total $1,000.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Current" header.
  2. Click the "Current" header again.
  3. Click the "Current" header a third time.
  4. Click the "1-30 Days" header.
  5. Click the "1-30 Days" header again.
  6. Click the "1-30 Days" header a third time.
  7. Click the "31-60 Days" header.
  8. Click the "31-60 Days" header again.
  9. Click the "31-60 Days" header a third time.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list sorts by Current, largest first: customer B $300.00, customer C $200.00, customer A $100.00.

Step 2:

  • Reversed, smallest first: customer A, customer C, customer B.

Step 3:

  • Largest first again, as in step 1.

Step 4:

  • The list sorts by 1-30 Days, largest first: customer C $300.00, customer A $200.00, customer B $100.00.

Step 5:

  • Reversed, smallest first: customer B, customer A, customer C.

Step 6:

  • Largest first again, as in step 4.

Step 7:

  • The list sorts by 31-60 Days, largest first: customer A $300.00, customer B $200.00, customer C $100.00.

Step 8:

  • Reversed, smallest first: customer C, customer B, customer A.

Step 9:

  • Largest first again, as in step 7.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R1, A/R Summary and A/P Summary columns: “A/R Summary and A/P Summary: the name column, Location (when shown), Current, 1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, 91 And Over, Total.”
  • S2-R1: “Every column on all six reports sorts when its header is clicked, except A/P Unpaid Invoices' Vendor Name column (S2-N1). The columns are:”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
